verdict.rationale: Omnirush is a desktop app for working with a coding agent across your own projects. Per-chat model and effort selection implies multiple chats can coexist, and agent-created worktrees suggest parallel work. However, no evidence describes a unified view for overseeing or switching between several concurrent agent sessions. Missing for 10: explicit multi-session/parallel-agent management, a unified dashboard or session list, cross-project workspace documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
